info.title: ACCESS360 AFRICA API
info.description: Electrification investment, finance and delivery intelligence. Financial outputs come from the deterministic ACCESS FINANCE engine; nothing in this API is investment advice.

post.description:
CSV with latitude and longitude columns (names: lat/latitude and lon/lng/longitude); other columns become
properties.

connections_target.title: Connections Target
connections_target.description: Connections at the end of the ramp

start_quarter.title: Start Quarter
start_quarter.description: Operating quarter in which connections start (0 = COD quarter)

ramp_quarters.title: Ramp Quarters
ramp_quarters.description: Quarters to reach the target, linear

kwh_per_connection_month.title: Kwh Per Connection Month
kwh_per_connection_month.description: Initial consumption per active connection, kWh a month

demand_growth_pa.title: Demand Growth Pa
demand_growth_pa.description: Annual growth of consumption per connection

tariff_per_kwh.title: Tariff Per Kwh
tariff_per_kwh.description: Energy tariff at COD, LCY per kWh

fixed_charge_month.title: Fixed Charge Month
fixed_charge_month.description: Fixed charge per connection, LCY a month

connection_fee.title: Connection Fee
connection_fee.description: One-off fee paid by the customer at connection, LCY

monthly_income.title: Monthly Income
monthly_income.description: Typical monthly income of the class, LCY (affordability)

share_of_capex.title: Share Of Capex
share_of_capex.description: Share of construction capex funded by this tranche

tenor_years.title: Tenor Years
tenor_years.description: Years from COD to final repayment

upfront_fee.title: Upfront Fee
upfront_fee.description: Fee on commitment, paid at financial close

debt_basis.title: Debt Basis
debt_basis.description: Debt is sized as a share of construction capex, before or after the capital grant

dsra_quarters.title: Dsra Quarters
dsra_quarters.description: Quarters of debt service held in reserve

maintenance_reserve.title: Maintenance Reserve
maintenance_reserve.description: Fund battery replacements through a reserve built up evenly beforehand

lockup_dscr.title: Lockup Dscr
lockup_dscr.description: Distributions blocked when the quarter DSCR is below this

min_cash.title: Min Cash
min_cash.description: Minimum unrestricted cash; shortfalls are met by equity support

quarter.title: Quarter
quarter.description: Model quarter of disbursement (0 = financial close)

operating_year.title: Operating Year
operating_year.description: Operating year in which the grid arrives

compensation_pct_nbv.title: Compensation Pct Nbv
compensation_pct_nbv.description: Compensation as a share of net book value (asset transfer)

regulatory_source.title: Regulatory Source
regulatory_source.description: Citation of the country rule applied

GridArrival.title: GridArrival
GridArrival.description: Treatment if the main grid reaches the site. Must be supported by the country's verified rules.

tariff_indexation.title: Tariff Indexation
tariff_indexation.description: Share of inflation passed into tariffs

fx_lcy_per_usd.title: Fx Lcy Per Usd
fx_lcy_per_usd.description: Exchange rate at financial close, LCY per USD

fx_depreciation_pa.title: Fx Depreciation Pa
fx_depreciation_pa.description: Annual depreciation of LCY against USD

discount_rate_pa.title: Discount Rate Pa
discount_rate_pa.description: Nominal discount rate for project NPV

equity_target_irr_pa.title: Equity Target Irr Pa
equity_target_irr_pa.description: Target equity IRR used by the subsidy solver

fixed_pa.title: Fixed Pa
fixed_pa.description: Fixed operating cost per year at COD prices, LCY

per_connection_pa.title: Per Connection Pa
per_connection_pa.description: Cost per active connection per year at COD prices, LCY

insurance_pct_capex.title: Insurance Pct Capex
insurance_pct_capex.description: Annual insurance as a share of initial capex

grid_cost_of_supply_per_kwh.title: Grid Cost Of Supply Per Kwh

pv_yield_kwh_per_kwp_pa.title: Pv Yield Kwh Per Kwp Pa

anchor_daytime_share.title: Anchor Daytime Share
anchor_daytime_share.description: Share of anchor energy used in daylight, served directly by PV (option F)

OptionCosts.title: OptionCosts
OptionCosts.description: All costs in LCY. Values must come from quotes, programme data or cited benchmarks.

review.description: Human review of the assumptions; required for VALIDATED status

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: Where an input value comes from. Shown next to every output that depends on it.

productive_users.title: Productive Users
productive_users.description: Mills, pumps, cold rooms and similar

distance_to_grid_km.title: Distance To Grid Km
distance_to_grid_km.description: None = unknown (grid options then fail their gate)

dispersed_household_share.title: Dispersed Household Share
dispersed_household_share.description: Households too far from the centre for a network

rbf_per_connection.title: Rbf Per Connection
rbf_per_connection.description: Results based payment per verified new connection, LCY

rbf_cap.title: Rbf Cap
rbf_cap.description: Programme cap on RBF payments, LCY

tariff_support_per_kwh.title: Tariff Support Per Kwh
tariff_support_per_kwh.description: Operating subsidy per billed kWh, LCY

deliverable_energy_kwh_pa.title: Deliverable Energy Kwh Pa
deliverable_energy_kwh_pa.description: Energy the design can deliver at the busbar per year (from the hourly study)

technical_loss.title: Technical Loss
technical_loss.description: Share of generated energy lost in the network

commercial_loss.title: Commercial Loss
commercial_loss.description: Share of delivered energy not billed (theft, meter faults)

diesel_share.title: Diesel Share
diesel_share.description: Share of generated energy from diesel (from the hourly study)

diesel_cost_per_kwh.title: Diesel Cost Per Kwh
diesel_cost_per_kwh.description: Fuel cost per diesel kWh at COD, LCY

battery_replacement_usd_per_kwh.title: Battery Replacement Usd Per Kwh
battery_replacement_usd_per_kwh.description: Replacement cost at COD prices, USD per kWh

battery_cost_decline_pa.title: Battery Cost Decline Pa
battery_cost_decline_pa.description: Annual real decline of battery replacement cost

Technical.title: Technical
Technical.description: Engineering inputs from the design study. The engine does not size or dispatch the system.

Weights.title: Weights
Weights.description: Initial design weights, configurable. Not a validated scientific standard.
